blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Everything is matter, and matter is made of tiny particles. How those particles move decides its state.

blocks.title: States of matter
items: Solid: fixed shape and fixed volume
Liquid: fixed volume, takes the shape of its container
Gas: spreads out to fill any container

blocks.title: Inside an atom
items: Neutron: no charge, in the nucleus
Electron: negative, moves around the nucleus

blocks.body: A molecule is two or more atoms bonded together.
